title: Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes — Co-Brand Card Credit on the Reinstatement Fee
content:
Card members are given a co-brand card credit against the reinstatement fee of a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes trip. The credit follows the miles credited to the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program by co-brand card partner accrual entries dated in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date.

| Miles from co-brand card partner accrual entries in the last 12 months | Co-brand card credit |
|---|---|
| 60000 or more | 20 USD |
| 25000 to fewer than 60000 | 10 USD |
| fewer than 25000 | nothing |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** 60000 miles gives 20 USD and 59999 gives 10 USD; 25000 gives 10 USD and 24999 gives nothing. Miles from flight accruals or other partners are not added in.
